reason: the red-team lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: red-team lens, low: DSDIFF-3 (the done_sentinel guard) checks that both events are emitted but does not assert the event payload's terminated_reason field, while DSDIFF-1 and DSDIFF-2 both do; a regression that corrupts the terminated_reason value for done_sentinel would leave DSDIFF-3 green. (plugins/agent/build/tests/build-test.sh: "    "[DSDIFF-3] build.discrepancy.detected emitted for done_sentinel+0files" \"; fix: test)

red-team lens, low: The new elif branch suppresses build.discrepancy.detected when scope_violation_mode is true (identical guard to the done_sentinel branch), but no test covers this suppression path for no_done_sentinel or router_out_of_turns; the issue states 'whatever the reason the call ended' and the guard is silently inherited, not explicitly designed for these new cases. (plugins/agent/build/lib/summary.sh: "    elif [[ ( "$terminated_reason" == "no_done_sentinel" || \"; fix: test)
